pages.text: Mobs that spawn with enchanted equipment are $(#7A2FBF)guaranteed to drop it$() when killed by a player or wolf (as in vanilla) - but $(bold)only if the gear has at least one non-common enchantment$().$(br2)A zombie with only Unbreaking or Sharpness still uses the vanilla drop chance. Also applies to all tridents.$(br2)$(italic)Makes more sense with Loot Rework.$()

Which enchantments are ignored is controlled by $(#7A2FBF)#penchant:ignore_guaranteed_drop$(). By default that tag includes $(#7A2FBF)#penchant:common$(), so only genuinely notable gear is guaranteed.$(br2)A datapack can add or remove entries without touching code.
